description: Follow-up of defk-zep. After safepoints spill only live locals, the Keccak round loop (a short flat loop, no safepoint inside) still has 6-11 stack stores+loads per round in the yielding kernel and 0 under yield: false; 16 MB is ~20.7 ms vs ~18.3 ms (under load). What stays live across the hot loop only in yielding kernels: defk_ticks and defk_budget (two registers where one countdown would do: DEFK_SP as (defk_left -= W) <= 0), defk_rs (read by every loop header's resume dispatch), and the short loop's rem, live across the loop only for DEFK_TICKS(rem + 1) after it (charging on entry, as flat == :exits already does, is equivalent for a plain loop and frees it; tried in defk-zep: 9 -> 7 spills in two orderings, inside noise on time). Measure with the spill counter approach in defk-zep's comment (cc -S with build.ex's cflags, count [sp] loads/stores in the loop with the most ror).

> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement
**Summary:** Experiment: cut the registers yield bookkeeping keeps live in hot short loops (one countdown instead of defk_ticks + defk_budget; charge a plain short loop on entry); adopt only if it measurably helps

**Current behavior:**
In the Keccak round loop (a short flat loop, no safepoint inside), the yielding kernel keeps 6-11 stack stores+loads per round that yield: false does not have; 16 MB takes ~20.7 ms vs ~18.3 ms (under load). Live across the loop only in yielding kernels: defk_ticks and defk_budget (two registers where one countdown would do: DEFK_SP as (defk_left -= W) <= 0), defk_rs (read by every loop header's resume dispatch), and the short loop's rem, live only for DEFK_TICKS(rem + 1) after it. defk-zep tried charging on entry: 9 -> 7 spills, time inside noise.

**Desired behavior:**
- Try the single countdown, and charging a plain short loop on entry, separately and together. Measure spills (cc -S with the build's cflags, count stack loads/stores in the hottest loop, as in defk-zep's comment) and time (Keccak 16 MB and two other short-loop examples, interleaved repeats, quiet machine or marked provisional).
- Adopt a change only if spills drop and time improves beyond noise, with the runtime contract intact (tick gap unchanged, yields and resume correct, adaptive slices from defk-04y still work). Otherwise revert and record the result.
- Either way record the numbers and conclusion in docs/performance.md.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] Spill counts and timings before/after per variant, in docs/performance.md
- [ ] If adopted: full suite, forced-yield tests and the tick-gap bench pass/unchanged; `mix docs`, `mix credo --strict` clean
- [ ] If not adopted: no code change merged; the report says why

**Out of scope:**
- Changing safepoint placement or the slice length; defk_rs resume dispatch redesign (note ideas only)

title: Yield bookkeeping costs registers in hot short loops: Keccak keeps 6-11 spills per round that yield: false does not have
